facts.text: I've had a loss of vision.
I've had cataract surgery with artificial lenses put in both eyes.
For a long time I've used latanoprost 0.005% drops in both eyes every night for the glaucoma.
Three weeks ago I was started on Simbrinza drops (brimonidine 0.1%/brinzolamide 0.1%) for my glaucoma, twice a day in both eyes.

findings.name: visual acuity
findings.result: 20/400 in the right eye; 20/200 in the left eye.

findings.name: pupil examination
findings.result: Pupils equally reactive; no relative afferent pupillary defect.

findings.name: intraocular pressure
findings.result: 24 mm Hg right eye (OD); 23 mm Hg left eye (OS).

findings.name: slit-lamp examination
findings.result: Quiet anterior chambers, shallow in the periphery.

findings.name: ultrasound biomicroscopy
findings.result: Iridocorneal apposition with 360° choroidal effusions in both eyes.

findings.name: manifest refraction
findings.result: Myopic shift of 3 diopters in each eye.

aliases: drug-induced bilateral choroidal effusion with angle closure
gold.reasoning: 1. Brinzolamide–induced effusions were considered given its sulfamate moiety similar to topiramate and acetazolamide — “we initially hypothesized the choroidal effusions were due to brinzolamide … and therefore, has the potential to cause this idiosyncratic reaction.” 2. Latanoprost was also considered for its ability to increase uveoscleral outflow and disrupt the blood-aqueous barrier in pseudophakic eyes — “Latanoprost increases aqueous flow into [the] uveoscleral outflow pathway and could disrupt blood-aqueous barrier in pseudophakic eyes.”

f001: The source does not say which eye or whether both eyes lost vision; acuity is reduced in both eyes on examination (x001).
f004: Pseudophakia (artificial lens in both eyes) worded as previous cataract surgery with lens implants.

x001.source_text: visual acuity was 20/400 in the right eye and 20/200 in the left eye

x002.source_text: Pupils were equally reactive without a relative afferent pupillary defect.

x003.source_text: Intraocular pressures were 24 mm Hg OD and 23 mm Hg OS.

x004.source_text: Slit-lamp examination revealed quiet anterior chambers that were shallow in the periphery.

x005.source_text: Indentation gonioscopy showed closed angles in both eyes.

x006.source_text: Ultrasound biomicroscopy demonstrated iridocorneal apposition with 360° choroidal effusions in both eyes.

x007.source_text: Manifest refraction revealed a myopic shift of 3 diopters in each eye.

leakage.reason: 'open-angle' is part of her known earlier diagnosis (open-angle glaucoma), which she was told; it is not the gold angle closure.
Gonioscopy result 'closed angles' is the examination's answer and shows the angle closure; kept because it is what the doctor is told.

notes: Index visit: the emergency presentation with acute vision loss and headache (s001-s010; all examinations are from that visit).
Simbrinza started three weeks before presentation is kept with its timing in the medication fact; it is the key history clue.
Intraocular pressure, gonioscopy and refraction are eye examinations; ultrasound biomicroscopy is an imaging test.
